metadata.repo_type_justification: Application source code (COBOL) with deployable batch entry point (JCL EXEC PGM=PAYRUN) and persistent data access. Classified as application.
metadata.archetype_justification: Reads from persistent indexed employee file (SSN, bank accounts, pay rates) and writes computed payroll output. Persistent state with write operations classifies as stateful-crud.

tech_stack.architecture: Mainframe batch processing (z/OS + EC2 file gateway)

findings.title: No API Interface — Batch File Exchange Only
findings.description: The system has no REST, GraphQL, or AsyncAPI interface. It is a COBOL batch program orchestrated by JCL, exchanging data via fixed-width flat files transmitted over plaintext FTP to an EC2 gateway at 10.0.7.40.
findings.gap: No API layer exists. Integration requires file-based exchange or mainframe job submission.
findings.recommendation: Expose the payroll calculation logic behind a REST API or wrap the batch job trigger as an API endpoint.

findings.title: Non-Idempotent Batch Execution
findings.description: The batch job is not idempotent. Running PAYRUN twice for the same pay period produces duplicate output records. No idempotency key, no deduplication, no duplicate detection mechanism.
findings.gap: No idempotency mechanism. Duplicate job submission results in duplicate payroll output.
findings.recommendation: Add a pay-period identifier check at job start that detects and rejects duplicate runs.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND batch job is non-idempotent.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The system performs write operations (payroll output generation and FTP delivery). A write-enabled agent triggering this batch without idempotency creates duplicate payroll records.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: No machine identity authentication exists. The only credential is a hardcoded FTP username/password in the JCL. No mechanism to identify which agent or service triggered the batch job.
findings.gap: No machine identity infrastructure. Cannot authenticate callers or attribute actions to specific principals.
findings.recommendation: Implement service account authentication for job submission with principal attribution.

findings.title: No Immutable Audit Logging
findings.description: No audit logging exists. Only JCL SYSOUT which is not immutable or tamper-evident. No record of authenticated principals for financial operations.
findings.gap: No immutable audit trail. SOX compliance exposure for payroll/financial operations.
findings.recommendation: Implement immutable audit logging with principal attribution and tamper-evident storage.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no audit logging exists for financial write operations.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: System performs write operations (payroll generation, FTP delivery of financial data). Write-enabled agent actions on financial data require immutable audit trails for compliance.

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback Capability
findings.description: No compensation or rollback capability exists. Partial failures leave the system in indeterminate state. FTP step has no error handling.
findings.gap: No rollback, no compensation, no partial-failure recovery.
findings.recommendation: Add checkpoint/restart logic and error handling for multi-step batch execution.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no rollback for multi-step write workflow.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The batch performs a multi-step write workflow (compute payroll, write output, FTP delivery). Failure at any step leaves partial state with no recovery mechanism.

findings.title: Unscoped Sensitive Data Access (SSN, Bank Accounts)
findings.description: System processes SSN (EMP-SSN), bank accounts (EMP-ACCT), pay rates, and net compensation with no field-level access scoping. All fields equally accessible with no filtering.
findings.gap: B1: No mechanism to exclude sensitive fields from data access. B2: No access differentiation between sensitive and non-sensitive data. B3: No data classification metadata.
findings.recommendation: Implement field-level access controls separating SSN/bank account access from general payroll data.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND B1 fired — sensitive fields (SSN, bank accounts) returned without scoping.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The employee master file contains SSN and bank account numbers with no mechanism to filter or scope access. Any consumer receives all fields including highly sensitive PII.

b1.reasoning: No field-level filtering — SSN and bank accounts accessible to any consumer of the employee data.

b2.reasoning: No access control differentiation — single shared access grants all data.

b3.reasoning: No formal data classification metadata exists.

findings.title: No Data Residency Controls for Regulated PII
findings.description: US SSN and financial data transmitted via plaintext FTP with no residency controls, no encryption, no region constraints, and no documented compliance policy.
findings.gap: No data residency policy. No encryption in transit. Regulated PII transmitted without protection.
findings.recommendation: Document residency requirements, replace plaintext FTP with encrypted transfer, implement region-pinning.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND regulated PII (SSN, financial data) transmitted without residency controls.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: System processes US SSN and bank account data subject to privacy regulations. Plaintext FTP transmission with no region constraints means an agent could inadvertently route data to non-compliant jurisdictions.

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions Infrastructure
findings.description: No authorization model exists. No IAM policies, no RACF granular profiles, no role definitions. Cannot differentiate access levels.
findings.gap: No scoped permissions. Cannot grant read-only vs full access.
findings.recommendation: Implement role-based access with separate profiles for job submission, data read, and data write.

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: No action-level authorization. Single monolithic batch with no operation-level permissions. Cannot restrict read vs write vs execute.
findings.gap: No fine-grained RBAC or ABAC. Cannot restrict agent to read-only.
findings.recommendation: Decompose into separate read and write operations with independent authorization.

findings.title: No Identity Propagation or Delegation
findings.description: No identity propagation. Shared FTP credential with no per-caller attribution. Cannot distinguish agent-as-self vs agent-on-behalf-of-user.
findings.gap: No identity context passed through service calls. All actions appear from shared identity.
findings.recommendation: Implement identity-aware job submission capturing and propagating requesting principal.

findings.title: Hardcoded Plaintext Credentials in Source Control
findings.description: FTP credentials hardcoded in plaintext in JCL: username 'payroll', password 'PayR0ll2003!' visible in source. Committed to version control with no rotation capability.
findings.gap: No secrets management. Hardcoded credentials vulnerable to leak via prompt injection or code exposure.
findings.recommendation: Remove hardcoded credentials immediately. Implement Secrets Manager with automated rotation. Replace FTP with SFTP.

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension Mechanism
findings.description: No mechanism to suspend or revoke agent identities. No identities exist to suspend. Cannot isolate misbehaving agent without full system shutdown.
findings.gap: No identity suspension capability.
findings.recommendation: Implement revocable service identities with immediate disable capability.

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls
findings.description: No concurrency controls. DISP=SHR allows concurrent reads with no locking. Concurrent execution would produce duplicate/corrupt output.
findings.gap: No optimistic locking, no mutex, no duplicate run detection.
findings.recommendation: Implement execution-level mutex and run-sequence identifier.

findings.title: No Circuit Breakers or Resilience Patterns
findings.description: No circuit breakers, retry logic, or timeout configurations. FTP step to EC2 gateway has no error handling — failures cascade without protection.
findings.gap: No resilience for external FTP dependency.
findings.recommendation: Add retry logic with exponential backoff and timeout for FTP step.

findings.title: No Blast Radius or Transaction Limits
findings.description: No transaction limits. Batch processes ALL employees without configurable scope. Single execution affects entire employee population with no per-run limits.
findings.gap: No blast radius limits. No configurable transaction scope per identity.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable transaction limits — maximum records per run, pay-period scope validation.

findings.title: No Draft/Pending State for Review
findings.description: No draft or pending state. Output committed and transmitted immediately upon batch completion. No reviewable intermediate state.
findings.gap: All write operations immediately committed. No human review gate.
findings.recommendation: Implement PENDING state between payroll computation and output transmission.

findings.title: No Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No approval gates. Batch runs unconditionally to completion once triggered with no human approval step.
findings.gap: Cannot require human approval for high-value operations.
findings.recommendation: Implement threshold-based approval gates for high-value payroll runs.

findings.title: No PII Redaction in Logs or Transmission
findings.description: No PII redaction. SSN and bank account data transmitted in plaintext via FTP. No masking in SYSOUT logs. No log scrubbing.
findings.gap: PII unprotected in logs and network transmission.
findings.recommendation: Implement PII redaction in all logging. Replace plaintext FTP with encrypted transfer. Mask SSN in non-essential output.

findings.title: No Async Support for 5-7 Hour Batch
findings.description: Batch runs 5-7 hours with no job status API, no polling endpoint, no webhook callback. No way to query progress.
findings.gap: No async patterns for long-running operation.
findings.recommendation: Implement job submission with status polling mechanism.

findings.title: No Queryable Current State
findings.description: No queryable state API. Employee data accessible only via COBOL I/O on mainframe. Cannot inspect state before acting.
findings.gap: No read-before-write capability. No external query interface.
findings.recommendation: Expose queryable state layer for employee and job status data.

findings.title: Shared QA Region Only — No Isolated Sandbox
findings.description: Only a shared QA region exists for testing. No isolated sandbox with synthetic data for agent testing.
findings.gap: No production-equivalent staging with data isolation.
findings.recommendation: Establish isolated staging environment with synthetic payroll data.

findings.title: No Input Validation or Schema Enforcement
findings.description: No input validation. Records processed without data type or range checks. No validation for hours, rates, SSN format. Malformed data processed silently.
findings.gap: No validation at any boundary. Incorrect data produces incorrect payroll calculations.
findings.recommendation: Add input validation for employee hours, pay rates, SSN format with structured error reporting.

findings.title: No Temporal Metadata or Freshness Signaling
findings.description: No timestamps in employee records. No freshness signaling. FICA wage base hardcoded at stale 2019 value ($132,900).
findings.gap: No temporal metadata. No mechanism to detect or communicate data staleness.
findings.recommendation: Add temporal metadata fields and automated staleness detection for reference data.

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or Breaking Change Detection
findings.description: No schema versioning. Fixed-width 120-byte file format with no version identifier, no documentation, no breaking change detection.
findings.gap: No versioning. Format changes would silently break all consumers.
findings.recommendation: Document file format as versioned schema with format version headers.

findings.title: No Distributed Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: No tracing or structured logging. Unstructured JCL SYSOUT only. Cannot trace agent-triggered executions end-to-end.
findings.gap: No tracing infrastructure. No correlation IDs.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured logging with unique execution IDs and trace context propagation.

findings.title: Zero Automated Test Coverage
findings.description: No automated tests exist. Manual validation in shared QA region only. No regression detection capability.
findings.gap: Zero test coverage. No CI pipeline.
findings.recommendation: Create automated tests for payroll calculation logic and end-to-end batch verification.

findings.title: No Encryption at Rest for Sensitive Data
findings.description: No encryption at rest. Employee master file containing SSN and bank accounts stored unencrypted on z/OS datasets.
findings.gap: Sensitive PII and financial data unencrypted at rest.
findings.recommendation: Enable dataset encryption for PII-containing files. Apply KMS-equivalent key management.

findings.title: No Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface exists. Machine-readable API specification is not applicable for the current batch architecture.
findings.gap: No API surface to document.
findings.recommendation: Create OpenAPI specification when API layer is introduced.

findings.title: No Structured Error Responses
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface. Structured error responses not applicable. COBOL has minimal error handling (EOF detection only).
findings.gap: No API responses to structure.
findings.recommendation: Design structured error response schema as part of API modernization.

findings.title: Fixed-Width Flat File Output Format
findings.description: Output is 120-byte fixed-width flat file. Positionally encoded fields with no delimiters, no JSON, no XML. Requires custom parsing.
findings.gap: Non-standard format incompatible with LLM consumption.
findings.recommendation: Modernize to JSON output format with named fields.

findings.title: No Event Emission Capability
findings.description: No event emission. No webhooks, no SNS/EventBridge, no Kafka. System writes file and FTPs it only.
findings.gap: No event-driven integration possible.
findings.recommendation: Add event emission (SNS notification) on job completion.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting (No API Surface)
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface. API-layer rate limiting is not applicable. Batch scheduled via CA-7.
findings.gap: No API layer to rate-limit.
findings.recommendation: Include rate limiting in API modernization plan.

findings.title: No Data Quality Monitoring
findings.description: No data quality monitoring. Tax tables updated manually with known drift (2019 FICA wage base still hardcoded). No completeness metrics.
findings.gap: No quality metrics or automated freshness checking.
findings.recommendation: Implement data quality checks for reference data currency.

findings.title: Abbreviated but Interpretable Field Names
findings.description: COBOL data names use mainframe-era abbreviated conventions (EMP-ID, EMP-SSN, WS-GROSS). Interpretable but require COBOL familiarity.
findings.gap: Abbreviated names need mapping to modern semantic names for API exposure.
findings.recommendation: Create data dictionary mapping COBOL fields to full semantic names.

findings.title: No Data Catalog or Metadata Layer
findings.description: No data catalog. COBOL FD section is the only schema documentation. No Glue Data Catalog, no data dictionary file.
findings.gap: No machine-readable metadata layer.
findings.recommendation: Document data model in JSON Schema format independent of COBOL source.

findings.title: No Alerting (No API Surface)
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface. Alerting on API error rates and latency not applicable for batch architecture.
findings.gap: No API surface to alert on.
findings.recommendation: Include alerting in API modernization plan.

findings.title: No Infrastructure as Code
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface and no auth surface. Infrastructure governance not applicable. No IaC exists — manually managed mainframe.
findings.gap: No IaC. All infrastructure manually managed.
findings.recommendation: Include IaC (Terraform/CDK) in modernization effort.

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface. No CI/CD pipeline exists. Files copied to source control in 2021 with no prior history.
findings.gap: No CI/CD. No automated build or deployment.
findings.recommendation: Establish CI/CD pipeline as part of modernization.

findings.title: No Rollback Capability
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface. No deployment rollback. GDG provides output versioning but not automated rollback.
findings.gap: No automated rollback capability.
findings.recommendation: Include rollback capability in modernization plan.

evaluations.title: Rate Limit Documentation and Headers
evaluations.reason: No API/HTTP surface exists — no rate limiting or throttling surface to document. Informational-Absence Suppression applied.

evaluations.title: Graceful Degradation Signaling
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no P0 priority specified and critical path not confirmed for agent workflow context.

evaluations.title: Selective Query Support
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — service has no list/query endpoints (batch processing only).

evaluations.title: Business Outcome Metrics
evaluations.reason: No metrics or telemetry surface exists — no observability surface to assess. Informational-Absence Suppression applied.

items.summary: Resolve all 7 BLOCKERs and critical RISK-SAFETY findings. Focus on identity infrastructure, audit logging, API layer introduction, and data protection controls.
Address remaining RISK-SAFETY and RISK-QUALITY findings — identity propagation, blast radius limits, async support, queryable state, input validation, and observability.
Address INFO findings and remaining quality gaps — engineering maturity, documentation, discoverability, and modernization foundation.

recommended_actions.action: Introduce API layer with machine identity
recommended_actions.rationale: The system has no API and no identity. These three BLOCKERs are interdependent — an API requires identity, and audit logging requires identity. Address together.

recommended_actions.action: Replace plaintext FTP with encrypted transfer and implement data residency controls
recommended_actions.rationale: Hardcoded credentials and plaintext transmission of SSN/bank data is the highest immediate security risk. Can be addressed independently of API modernization.
Non-idempotent batch with no rollback creates data integrity risk. Required for any agent-triggered execution.
SSN and bank accounts accessible without scoping. Requires decomposition of monolithic access into scoped operations.

recommended_actions.action: Establish human-in-the-loop controls for payroll execution
recommended_actions.rationale: Payroll is a high-stakes operation. Draft states and approval gates prevent agent-initiated financial errors.
